name: paged list: the offset grows by the limit, not by the rows returned
why: org/MB-POH-sync-withDiscogs.org Phase 2: a browse page may hold fewer rows than the limit (a release browse's 500-track cap); offsetting by the limit skips rows.

edits.replace: const res = await st.spec.ask(Math.ceil(st.rows.length / _MB_PAGED_LIMIT) * _MB_PAGED_LIMIT, st.wanted, st.pages + 1);
